articles.headline: Dembélé, Torres star as PSG score 6 to launch UCL defense
articles.description: Ballon d'Or winner Ousmane Dembélé scored titleholder Paris Saint-Germain's first goals of the new Champions League campaign, and his first goals the season, when he netted twice in a 6-1 home win against Slovan Bratislava on Wednesday.

images.alt: Ousmane Dembélé, left, and Ferran Torres celebrate after combining on a PSG goal against Slovan Bratislava in the Champions League.

articles.headline: Liverpool vs. Atlético Madrid player ratings as Alexis Mac Allister scores the winner in Champions League comeback win
articles.description: Liverpool got their UEFA Champions league campaign off to the perfect start as they came from behind to beat Atlético Madrid 2-1 -- with goals from Dominik Szboszlai and Alexis Mac Allister.

images.name: Mac Allister [1296x729]
images.caption: Alexis Mac Allister scored a screamer to complete the turnaround for Liverpool as they beat Atlético Madrid 2-1.
images.credit: Liverpool FC/Liverpool FC via Getty Images

images.name: Szobozslai [1296x729]
images.caption: Dominik Szobozslai scored the equaliser for Liverpool after a wonderful backheel flick from Ronald Araújo.
